assumptions.description: All labels assume a generic general-trading or professional-services SME purchasing goods and services as overhead or staff expenditure, NOT as trading stock. These labels are NOT valid for businesses whose primary trade overlaps with a Reg 26/27 disallowed category (e.g. a car dealer's vehicles, a clinic's medical supplies are claimable trading inputs). See knowledge-base/slices/business-context.md for the full statement of this assumption.
context_claimable_examples: Car dealer: vehicle purchases and running costs are trading stock / demonstrator inputs — claimable
Medical clinic: medical supplies and staff medical costs are direct service inputs — claimable
Insurance broker: staff medical & accident premiums may be a product input — seek specialist advice
assumptions.production_limitation: The production reasoning pass must receive the client business nature via a new ClientConfig field before being enabled for non-generic-SME clients. See roadmap item T2.7.x in knowledge-base/AgentAssist-Technical-Roadmap-v3.md.
